Recognized for problem solving under pressure and for delivering critical systems in multi-stakeholder, multicultural environments.

Experienced <<job_title>> with broad competences in cloud and system integration. Strong problem solving skills make the profile very versatile. Works with project management to shape the right solution: advises on options, risks, costs and impact on other business processes. Used to multicultural environments under high pressure.

experiences.title: Infrastructure Solution Architect
experiences.role_summary: In the Organizing Committee I was part of the Infrastructure team (5 people). We provided the hardware for the Games (PCs, printers, phones, servers) and the services built on it (Office, MDM, mail, printing), and we oversaw the cloud infrastructure on GCP and Alibaba Cloud for the applications delivered in IaaS mode.
duties: Solution Architect and Product Owner for two Games projects delivered in IaaS mode: 'File Transfer', a web application to move files in and out of a protected network, and 'File Sharing', a high performance SMB file repository built for a specific need of the Venue Design team.

Owned the printing solution for the Games, as both Product Owner and Solution Architect: collected the requirements, got approvals from the Cybersecurity team, designed the solution and kept the documentation up to date. Followed up with the hardware vendor until the solution was installed.

Gathered requirements, wrote RFQs and validated vendor proposals for the cloud projects above, balancing mandatory delivery time, required SLAs, costs and effort, with the 'Business Impact Assessment' as reference.
Ensured technical compliance with company policies and guided solution providers through the internal approval process.
Defined, documented and tested operational procedures (installation, configuration) for about 1,100 printers across 9 main use cases, some of them critical for the Games.
Worked shifts in the Technical Operations Center, troubleshooting issues from device logistics to compliance; solved critical problems on my own, also at night.

Worked with the Applications Team on the technical side of contracts for cloud resources of applications delivered in IaaS mode: wrote the infrastructure part of the RFQs, defined RACI matrices, validated proposals, architecture and costs.
Supported the Applications Team in managing the Chinese cloud vendor (Alibaba).
Validated the design of the common Google Cloud infrastructure shared by all projects in IaaS mode, checking log routing and the site-to-site VPN with the cloud provider.

experiences.title: Technical Solution Architect
experiences.context: Continental Multi-Sport Games 2022 -- Results Distribution System
experiences.role_summary: My team supported the delivery of the 'Games Results' system, a mission critical software for the Games: it keeps the scores and generates the official web site. The software was developed in Europe; my team adapted it to the client's environment and to the requests of the system integrator.
duties: Technical bridge between the European development team and the Chinese system integrator (Alibaba). Mapped the system integrator's requirements onto the software architecture provided by the European team and adapted it to the client's needs.
Presented and discussed the system architecture with the client, in Chinese, in a difficult environment, while gathering non-functional requirements (high availability, performance, scalability).
Designed and implemented solutions to the customer's requests locally where possible; coordinated code changes with the European team.
Prepared environments for application deployment: configured DNS and Kubernetes, optimized Helm packages, solved deployment specific issues (e.g. Redis instability when master nodes restarted).
Solved synchronization issues between two isolated platforms owned by two different companies with rsync and inotify: designed the fix, presented it, got it approved and implemented it.
Team leader and mentor of a small team of 3 people.
Defined and documented backup/restore procedures able to meet the strict SLA of the Games.

The Results Distribution System was a core system with a strict SLA: recovery (RTO) within 2 hours in case of disaster. I guided my team through the Technical Rehearsals (full scale test events before the Games), where the Disaster Recovery (DR) procedures of the Results system were tested successfully against the SLA. (Note: the rehearsals were a very large event covering all Games systems: software, hardware, venue security, not only Results. I guided my team, NOT the rehearsals).
My team received the company's yearly excellence award, a monetary prize for outstanding performance, and informal compliments from the client's managers at the end of the Games.

experiences.title: Software Engineer -- IT Consultant
experiences.role_summary: IT consultant on a 'Tax & Customs' programme: ML services, cloud IAM, microservice modernization of a Java monolith, and production troubleshooting abroad.
duties: Turned a Machine Learning model from a Python notebook into a full microservice, improving the model's performance on the way. The service detected anomalies in customs declarations (imported goods) from X-Ray scans of cargo containers (VGG16 - Model Fine Tuning - Python - Image Processing - Softmax).

On a separate project, designed the IAM solution for least access privilege in a large system on Alibaba Cloud: separated the privileges for production and testing environments across several user groups (developers, database specialists) and isolated the production environment (Alibaba Cloud, IAM, Terraform).

R&D: worked with Business Analysts to define the new technology stack of the customs application. Documented and presented the solutions to the stakeholders and led a small team to implement them. The design followed reactive principles and patterns such as CQRS and saga, on Kubernetes on GCP. Designed and implemented the CI/CD pipelines on 'Jenkins X' and the observability layer on the LGTM stack (Grafana).

Following the point above, ported the 'Tax & Customs' application (a large Java/J2EE monolith) to microservices on Kubernetes together with a junior developer, up to a live demo with potential customers. The team worked with Agile methodologies and ceremonies.

Legacy application troubleshooting: often called in for critical production issues or performance bottlenecks. Once, on site at a customer in East Africa, I found serious stability and performance issues: the web server process died without leaving traces. In 10 days I found and fixed a memory leak (from post-mortem Java logs) and three critical infrastructure problems (unpatched WebLogic application server causing thread issues, database drivers, a failing database network card).

Impact in international contexts: in the case above the customer's team knew about problems that had been open for months but were not solving them. By talking to the right stakeholders I got them fixed. I also had the local team install monitoring (Zabbix), adding a layer of observability. By the end of my stay the customer's attitude toward the project had clearly improved, and they explicitly asked for me to come back.

experiences.title: Software Engineer & Network Administrator
experiences.role_summary: Software engineer and network administrator for a small technical consultancy serving large institutional companies (e.g. a national energy utility) with numerical simulation and HPC: C++ and Python simulation software plus Linux network administration.
duties: Developed C++ and Python software for numerical simulations and finite element analysis.
Mixed OS (Linux/Windows) network administration: implemented LDAP authentication and shared disk access for the consultancy.
The company open-sourced a C++ project I was responsible for. I still maintain it and it has an active user community on GitHub.

experiences.title: Software Developer
experiences.role_summary: Signa Systems S.p.A. specializes in digital signature, document preservation and services for banks and Public Administration. I was software developer and architect of a core component: the digital signature library.
duties: Designed, developed and maintained the Java digital signature library, a foundation component of the company's document management and preservation solution. It integrated with the browser through an applet and read smart cards through JNI.
Contributed to a software (named PayDesk) that let Public Administration send digitally signed payment orders to banks.
Promoted emerging technologies, including presenting AWS Cloud Computing to company management as early as 2009.
Introduced a code generation framework that generates code from annotated UML diagrams (AndroMDA). It sped up development by generating the structure of the code (about 60% of it).
